title: SDK Skill Browser Pipeline
desc: Full pipeline to generate a live marketing skill browser webpage from wkappbot HQ skill catalog. Reads 416 public skills, masks .env secrets, 44-char preview truncation with GitHub OAuth Pro unlock, split-panel UI, auto-rebuilds via GHA on push.
steps: RUN: python D:/GitHub/wkappbot-sdk/scripts/build-skill-page.py -- reads HQ catalog, filters wkappbot-* apps only, masks .env values, outputs docs/skills/index.html
STRUCTURE: docs/index.html (wkappbot product intro) + docs/skills/index.html (split-panel skill browser with Sonnet reflection hero). GitHub Pages source: main branch /docs
SPLIT-PANEL UI: left panel = skill list with category accordion + search. Right panel = skill detail on click. Pro skills show 44-char preview with blur overlay and GitHub OAuth unlock.
PRIVACY: app allowlist (wkappbot-* only, excludes personal-docs/wkautoquant/invest-kr). .env values masked at build time. JSON schema hidden in skills-data.js variable.
GHA AUTO-REBUILD: .github/workflows/build-skill-page.yml triggers on push to main. Also triggers via repository_dispatch from Core repo push (skill-catalog-updated event).
PRO UNLOCK: JS checks GitHub OAuth token in localStorage. Fetches api.github.com/repos/kiexpert/wkappbot-harness/collaborators. Collaborator = Pro subscriber = full step content unlocked.
HERO SECTION: Sonnet reflection quote from sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref + AK Platform pitch from wkappbot-the-artificial-knowledge-platform. Scroll down to skill browser.

QA CHECK: bash scripts/check-skill-browser.sh -- curl-based smoke test (no CDP needed, public page). Checks: HTTP 200 for /skills/ and /, skill card count > 10, Sonnet/harness hero text, Pro lock elements, local docs/skills/index.html freshness. Exit 0 = all pass. Add to gg-main ISSUE 9 section. Run after every push to verify Pages deployment.

SKILL TREE QA (check-skill-tree.sh): wkappbot skill list extracts IDs via sed pattern s/.*(\([^)]*\)).*/\1/ NOT awk. Fixed pattern for T2/T3: grep -E -(howto|ref|t23-) then sed extract. Script finds skills missing parent T1 backlink. Run: bash scripts/check-skill-tree.sh

AUTO-HEAL backlinks: when check-skill-tree.sh finds NO_PARENT_LINK, auto-fix via: wkappbot skill edit ID --add-step 'Parent T1: wkappbot skill read BASE'. Script becomes self-healing: find orphan + auto-add parent step + report FIXED. Same pattern as wkappbot self-healing principle -- document AND enforce.

3-STATE AUTH LOGIC: (1) no localStorage token = show PAT input prompt. (2) token stored but fetch raw.githubusercontent.com/kiexpert/wkappbot-harness returns 404 = logged in but not subscriber, show Upgrade CTA. (3) token stored and 200 = collaborator, unlock full steps. Two data sources: skills-data-public.js from public SDK repo (44-char preview), skills-data-full.js from private wkappbot-harness (full steps). The 404 vs 200 from private repo IS the auth check -- no separate collaborator API call needed.

ARCHITECTURE v2 (2026-06-04, confirmed): (1) docs/skills/index.html = app list NAV ONLY (no hero, no pricing, no skill cards). (2) docs/skills/{app}/index.html = per-app skill list. (3) docs/skills/{app}/{id}.html = skill content ONLY (no sidebar by default). (4) SIDEBAR PATTERN: each skill page embeds compact nav tree, hidden by default. Toggle via Browse button, state in localStorage -- persists across skill navigation. (5) SEO: nav tree in HTML (crawlable), not fetched dynamically. (6) SONNET REFLECTION: belongs on docs/index.html product page, NOT skills/index.html. WRONG: mixing hero+pricing+cards+treeview on one page.

SIDEBAR UX SPEC (2026-06-04): skill page default = content only (no sidebar). Browse button top-left toggles sidebar. Sidebar: search input + app-grouped tree (details/summary). localStorage key sb_open remembers state across navigation. Nav tree is INLINE HTML in every skill page (~15KB compact: app+title+href only). NOT iframe, NOT fetch -- inline = SEO crawlable + works without server.

PROGRESSIVE ENHANCEMENT PATTERN (2026-06-04): (1) Static links = dry href to other skill pages (e.g. Next: gg-main). Search bots follow these links and index all skill pages without JS. (2) Tree menu = JS-only, activated by human click (Browse button). NOT auto-opened on page load -- bots never trigger it. (3) Related links to show on each skill page: T2/T3 siblings (same base ID), same-app skills (prev/next by title), parent skill breadcrumb. All as plain -- no onclick, no JS. (4) Result: bot crawls the full graph via static links; human gets tree UX on demand.

AI AGENT ACCESSIBILITY (2026-06-04): Claude Code or any AI agent can open a skill page URL and immediately extract next/prev skill URLs from the static <a href> links in the page. No JS execution needed. Pattern: fetch page -> parse <a class='skill-nav'> -> get href -> done. This makes the skill graph machine-readable without a separate API. wkappbot cdp eval can also read document.querySelectorAll('.skill-nav a') to get sibling/next URLs.
